title: xtext: proofs as text
description: ExtractText prints the proof of a lemma as text, in English or French, also with its tags or for a proof stopped midway (github.com/thery/coq_tmp).

title: cyp: texts as proofs
description: Cyp Lemma and CypFile check a proof written as text, node by node; a wrong node left as the goal ?c1 (github.com/thery/coq_tmp).

title: cyp tutorial
description: The cyp tutorial in one file to step through: proofs written as text, each formula tagged with its role, checked step by step (github.com/thery/coq_tmp, cyp/TUTORIAL.md).

title: pbp: proof by pointing
description: Select a part of the goal: a bar shows the pointing actions declared in Rocq (Point, Link…, Simplify here, Unfold here, Type of, Normal form, Disable notation…, yours); a click writes the line in the script, or shows a text (github.com/thery/coq_tmp).

title: Pointing actions: a tutorial in Elpi
description: First proofs made by clicks with Point and Link, then two actions written in Elpi step by step, Simplify here and Unfold here, all their code in the file: the bar grows as they are declared (github.com/thery/coq_tmp, point_actions_tutorial.v).

title: First proofs
description: A recursive function, a proof by induction, Search and lia.

title: Lists
description: Polymorphic functions on lists and proofs about them.

title: Several files
description: Definitions in one file, proofs in another which requires it.

title: Ltac2
description: A tactic written in Rocq's typed tactic language.

title: Extraction
description: An OCaml file from a Rocq function, to read or download.
